filename: Development of a Deep Learning Emulator for a Distributed Groundwater–Surface Water Model.pdf
title: Development of a Deep Learning Emulator for a Distributed Groundwater–Surface Water Model: ParFlow-ML
code_availability: https://github.com/hoangtv1899/ParFlow-NN and ParFlow model at https://github.com/parflow/parflow
testbed_rationale: Provides a reproducible benchmark for spatiotemporal emulation of a 3D coupled surface-subsurface physical model with available GitHub code and well-defined test domains.
pain_points: High computational burden of resolving 3D Richards equation and 2D kinematic wave overland flow equations at high spatial resolution
Vanishing gradients in recurrent neural networks over long time-horizon predictions
Lack of strict mass balance conservation enforcement in deep learning emulators
Spurious noise and fluctuation artifacts predicted by the recurrent architecture over cells with near-constant steady-state values
extraction_notes: ParFlow-ML emulates the entire 3D transient state (pressure head and relative saturation across five layers) of the distributed hydrologic model rather than a subgrid parameterization scheme.
